card.name: Injection site and needle angle wording
card.fires_on: Small linking words (into, in, the) right after an injection verb or route, just before the body site such as gluteal muscle, thigh or abdomen. Also digits in needle angles like 90° and dose ranges.

modes.label: Link word before injection site
modes.description: The word into, in or the follows inject or a route (intramuscularly, subcutaneously) and comes before a body site.
modes.example: The suggested initial dose is 60 mg, injected deeply<< into>> the gluteal muscle . Atrophy
